author: Inside Edition
description: A Vietnam Veteran who slapped a young baseball fan who did not stand during the national anthem is speaking to Inside Edition. The incident happened at a Chicago Cubs home game. Bob Chavez had chastised a young man sitting in front of him. When the fan remained seated, Chavez smacked him on his head. The young man looked stunned and stood up. Now, social media is lighting up with praise and condemnation.
title: Man Speaks Out After Slapping Sports Fan Who Didn't Stand For National Anthem

author: Inside Edition
description: An Oregon teen's thrifting business got a big boost when he scored a vintage basketball jacket at a local Goodwill. Quinn Brown says it caught his eye immediately. It turned out to be a warm up jacket that belonged to legendary Los Angeles Laker, Wilt Chamberlain, worn in 1972. Brown says it only cost him three dollars, but he says he knew it was worth more. After posting about his find online, Brown says Sotheby's contacted him. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Oregon Teen Sells $3 Thrifted Wilt Chamberlain Warmup Jacket For Almost $90G

author: Inside Edition
description: A family was reunited with their missing dog. Fig, an Australian shepherd, bolted after she heard loud fireworks outside her home in Lindsay, California. Owner Katie Cassaday and her kids worried that Fig would never come home. After 10 days of searching, the dog was found. Fig was delivered to the local sheriff's office by a good Samaritan, who found the dog wandering 30 miles from his home. Fig is now back in the loving arms of her grateful family.
title: Family Reunited With Dog After 10 Days Of Searching

author: Inside Edition
description: Two boys were delivered 10 hours apart in the same hospital. Now, at age 36, the men were dealt a stunning surprise – they claim they were switched at the hospital. Evelyn is Jeremy Morrison's biological mother but she says she raised Kyle Bylin, believing he was her son. Kyle Bylin's biological mom is Liz, and she says she raised Morrison. The families are suing the hospital in North Dakota. The hospital says it has "no evidence to support claims that Unity Medical Center or its staff were responsible for what occurred."
title: 2 Men Say They Were Switched At Birth 36 Years Ago

author: Inside Edition
description: According to the Frederick County Sheriff's Office in Maryland, Kaylee Hottle was a passenger in a Honda Accord that was involved in a single vehicle crash. The car's driver received non-life-threatening injuries, and a second passenger was uninjured – but Hottle was pronounced dead at the hospital. Hottle appeared in 2021's "Godzilla vs. Kong" and 2024's "Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire," for which she was nominated for a Saturn Award. She was 18 years old.
title: 'Godzilla vs. Kong' Star Is Dead At 18

author: Inside Edition
description: The birthplace of Adolf Hitler, in the Austrian town of Braunau, is being turned into a police station. Austria's government seized the property from its then-owner in 2016. Authorities want to make sure the structure doesn't become a pilgrimage site for right-wing extremists. The future Nazi leader was born there in 1889, and his family lived in the house for three years. A plaque outside the house notes that Hitler "was responsible for unprecedented humanitarian crimes."
title: Hitler's Austrian Birthplace Is Turned Into A Police Station
